text: Pradosha is the hour between day and night, and our tradition holds that what is unsettled can be set down there.
Shiva is worshipped as the one who takes what we cannot carry.
On this Masa Shivaratri, we invite you to connect with this ancient wisdom.
You may offer an abhishekam with water or milk, or simply light a deepam before His picture.
Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' as long as it feels natural.
Bilva leaves are a traditional offering if you have them, and know that your puja is no less sacred if you do not.
